findings: Correct title spelling is Imagens do Brasil. Saxofón Latinoamericano catalog dates the saxophone-and-piano work 1999.
Composer-published retailer index offers a 19-page alto saxophone/piano score and part, Renato Goulart#1302419, A0.1741457.
Duo Heimann-Braga recorded it for Miniaturas, Serestas e outras Imagens do Brasil during 2015 sessions. Performers are Erik Heimann Pais, saxophone, and Míriam Braga, piano.

Gilbert Garza's University of Iowa thesis discusses the work's choro, baião and batuque influences based on composer correspondence. That thesis download is an expired signedURL lead, so observations remain source-reported.
